The '''1970–71 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 35th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 20 September 1970 and ended on 13 June 1971. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their fifth Greek title and their first one in three years.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
